note: Scheduled source maintenance tasks (see .github/workflows/update-sources.yml and .github/update-sources-prompt.md). sourceId identifies an existing preset or a new tier for the agent to research and append. Missing presets trigger research even when shared page hashes are unchanged. Codex, Claude, Google, current Kimi, MiMo and MiniMax use ModelDial's per-model API-equivalent estimates; legacy Kimi remains paused; other entries use provider pricing pages. Legacy preset ids stay stable when plan names change. Actual prices and allowances belong in data/sources.json and are maintained by Actions. Agent settings: secret AGENT_API_KEY; variables AGENT_MODEL, AGENT_PROVIDER_ID, AGENT_BASE_URL.
